name: copy-button
title: Copy Button
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: An icon button that copies a value too long to type (protocol, access key, Pix code, token) to the clipboard. The icon turns into a check, or a cross on failure, for a moment, and the outcome is announced in a separate live region; labels are translatable and an optional tooltip shows them. Also exports `useCopyToClipboard` for other triggers, such as a menu item.
